sn6.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā Nerañjarāya tīre Ajapāla-nigrodha-mūle pathamābhisambuddho || || 2.
sn6.1:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || || 3.
sn6.1:1.4: Adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo || ||
sn6.1:1.5: Ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasamuditā ||
sn6.1:1.6: ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasamuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānam || yad idam idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppādo || ||
sn6.1:1.7: Idam pi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ || yad idaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbupadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ || ||
sn6.1:1.8: Ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ || pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ || so mamassa kilamatho || sā mamassa vihesā ti || || 4.
sn6.1:1.9: Apissudaṃ Bhagavantam imā acchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā || ||
sn6.1:4.1: Iti Bhagavato paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāya || || 6.
sn6.1:5.1: Atha kho Brahmuno sahampatissa Bhagavato cetasā ceto parivitakkam aññāya etad ahosi || ||
sn6.1:5.2: Nassati vata bho loko vinassati vata bho loko || yatra hi nāma Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhamma-desanāyā ti || || 7.
sn6.1:5.3: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya || evam evaṃ brahmaloke antarahito Bhagavato purato pātur ahosi || || 8.
sn6.1:5.4: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇa-jānu-maṇḍalaṃ pathaviyaṃ nihantvā yena Bhagavā ten-añjaliṃ pamāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn6.1:5.5: Desetu bhante Bhagavā dhammaṃ desetu Sugato dhammaṃ ||
sn6.1:5.6: Santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti
sn6.1:5.8: Idam avoca Brahmā sahampati || idaṃ vatvā athāparam etad avoca || ||
sn6.1:9.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesi || || 11.
sn6.1:9.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paraloka-vajja-bhaya-dassāvino viharante || || 12.
sn6.1:9.3: Seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jatāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni anto-nimuggaposīni || appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarikāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni samodakam ṭhitāni || appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakā accuggamma tiṭṭhanti anupalittāni udakena ||
sn6.1:9.4: Evam eva Bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante || || 13.
sn6.1:11.1: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati || katāvakāso kho mhi Bhagavato dhammadesanāyā ti || Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyī ti || || 1.
